title: Remember caption option in player, closes #2811

timeline.message: Remember caption option in player, closes #2811
timeline.author: Robin

diff.patch:

+    <string name="caption_user_set_key" translatable="false">caption_user_set_key</string>
 
     <!-- Content & History -->
     <string name="show_search_suggestions_key" translatable="false">show_search_suggestions</string>

timeline.body:
There had been feature requests like #1329 and #2392.
But instead of adding a new preference which seems to be generally not favourable, the request in #2811 seems actually pretty straight forward.
This PR implements it.

I have also considered the auto-generated subtitles (and hopefully internationalized, I have tested english and german phone languages). If auto-generated language was chosen last time by the user, the non auto-generated language will be preferred, but if the native chosen language is not available, the auto-generated variant will be used as a fallback.

Debug apk for testing: https://github.com/Redirion/NewPipe/releases/tag/v0.17.4cc

- [X] I carefully read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.
What does `!userPreferredLanguage.contains("(")` do? Please add a comment to ensure people can understand your code later.

reply.body: if the user already has set the auto-generated language (hence the check for "("), it is not useful to look for that as the first part of the if condition would match the caption language directly.

timeline.body: Thanks. This sounds like a useful addition. I'll review it in more detail later.
